in-game use: The freed Capital: the open yard at the top of Grave Row under the castle wall, west of the castle steps, at (34.5, 9.5), facing south; a cut-out prop about 4 m tall on its plinth
replaces: the primitive mirror of capital_props.gd (gallery_mirror: gilt frame, shader glass, shards)
description: A tall free-standing mirror in an ornate gilt frame with a crest and claw feet, on a low white stone plinth. The glass is deep silvered blue and cracked from the inside: a star of bright pale-blue cracks from one impact point a little right of centre, two broken rings round it, a cold light shining through the cracks as if a corridor of silver halls lies behind. A few shards of glass glint on the plinth and the ground. Primm's perfect gold, chipped. Family friendly, a little eerie, not frightening.
